Explanation of Adaptive Platform Software
Architecture
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
9.2.2.1 Defined interfaces
The interfaces of
State Management
are categorized into interfaces interfaces for
a SMControlApplication (see Section 9.2.2.1.1), interfaces for notification of StateMa-
chine transitions to any Adaptive Application (see Section 9.2.2.1.2), interfaces for in-
teraction with
Update and Configuration Management
(see Section 9.2.2.1.3),
and interfaces for Suspend-to-Ram (see Section 9.2.2.1.4).
9.2.2.1.1 Interfaces for a SMControlApplication
The
StateMachineService
and
UpdateAllowedService
interfaces provide a
means for an SMControlApplication to interact with
State Management
’s StateMa-
chine.
